notes: WArmy 0.4.4: workhorse tasks no longer stop before they are finished — when a run ends with plan steps still open, the system now keeps dispatching follow-up turns (with stall/repeat/step circuit breakers still in place) instead of giving up; per-turn tool budgets raised so code-heavy runs are not forced to wrap up after a few file reads; follow-up turns are told not to re-read files they already read; the per-step follow-up counter resets whenever real progress is made.
